title: Delta Guard Reconciler: safe rollback runner for config deltas and batching/caching hints
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Goal: Implement a Delta Guard Reconciler that evaluates and enforces safe config changes for batching/caching recommendations and other runtime tunables, automatically triggering guardrail checks and well-scoped rollbacks when regressions are detected. The reconciler will operate as a stateless controller that compares desired config deltas to observed runtime signals (latency p50/p95, tail token cost, cache hit rate, KV-cache miss rate, error rate). It must support declarative policies (safety bands, hysteresis, confidence thresholds) and an execution plan that can both apply staged changes (canary -> scaled rollout) and perform a surgical rollback of only the offending delta.
acceptance_criteria: Reconciler can ingest a config delta and produce a deterministic safety score (0-100) based on live metrics and policy rules
When safety score falls below threshold during canary, reconciler triggers automatic revert of the specific delta within configured SLA (<= 60s average revert latency)
Reconciler emits structured audit events for every apply/rollback with explainable reason and metric snapshots
Operator UI (Console) shows per-change timeline including pre/post metrics and confidence curve
Unit and integration tests simulate noisy metric streams and ensure no false positive rollbacks for transient spikes
design_decisions: Use a two-layer scoring model: rule-based guardrails (hard limits) plus a lightweight Bayesian confidence estimator for regression likelihood
Store minimal state in the controller (last-applied-delta id, last-safety-score) and rely on centralized time-series store for metric history to keep reconciler horizontally scalable
Rollback granularity is the delta id (not entire config), supporting partial undo and allowing dependent deltas to remain (requires dependency tracking by key)
Prefer pessimistic default policies (narrow batching increase, conservative cache TTL reductions) with an opt-in aggressive mode for experimental projects
Expose 'dry-run' simulation mode to preview safety score and estimated cost impact before applying changes
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: transient metric spikes cause spurious rollbacks -> Mitigation: implement hysteresis window + require sustained violation for N consecutive evaluation ticks

Risk: correlated changes across services may hide root cause -> Mitigation: dependency graph tracing and tag-based correlation to escalate to human review instead of automatic rollback for multi-service deltas
Risk: rollback flapping during unstable infra -> Mitigation: backoff + cooldown policy and sliding-window health composite metric
Risk: operator distrust if explainability is weak -> Mitigation: produce human-readable rationale and metric snapshots in audit events and Console UI
implementation_plan: MVP controller (0.1): accept deltas, compute rule-based safety score, integrate with metrics (Prometheus), and do single-delta canary rollback
MVP controller (0.2): add Bayesian confidence estimator, dry-run mode, structured audit events, and Console timeline panel
Integration: wire to deployments pipeline (config-apply webhook) and runtime agent (for fast revert commands)
Testing: fuzz metric generator, chaos runs on staging, and cost-regression simulation using historical traces
Rollout: start with low-impact experiments (non-critical model variants) then grad to Dedicated customers for opt-in trial
